features.title: Built for Field Accuracy & Agronomic Trust

detection.title: AI Leaf Disease Detection
detection.desc: Fine-tuned MobileNetV2 classifier trained on 15 classes of Tomato, Potato, and Bell Pepper leaves with 94% test accuracy.

gradcam.title: Explainable AI Heatmaps
gradcam.desc: Grad-CAM visual overlays highlight the exact infected regions on the leaf so farmers and officers can trust every prediction.

chatbot.title: Gemini AI Advisory Chatbot
chatbot.desc: Interactive bilingual farming assistant providing contextual treatment, dosage safety, and preventive agronomic advice.

officer.title: Agricultural Officer Review
officer.desc: Low-confidence scans (<70%) are automatically queued for district Agricultural Officers to verify and relabel for model retraining.

outbreakMap.title: District Outbreak Map
outbreakMap.desc: Interactive geospatial tracking across all 25 Sri Lankan districts to spot regional crop disease outbreaks early.

iot.title: ESP32 IoT Field Sensors
iot.desc: Optional real-time environmental telemetry monitoring soil moisture, ambient temperature, and leaf humidity.

howItWorks.title: From Field Leaf Photo to Actionable Treatment
howItWorks.subtitle: Designed for mobile phones in the field—no technical expertise required.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Snap a clear photo of an affected Tomato, Potato, or Bell Pepper leaf using your phone camera or upload from your gallery.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our MobileNetV2 model identifies the disease in seconds and generates a Grad-CAM heatmap pinpointing the lesion areas.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Receive symptoms, treatment steps, and prevention tips in Sinhala or English—backed by Agricultural Officer verification.

techStack.subtitle: From a farmer's leaf photo to an officer-verified diagnosis — every layer has one clear job.
techStack.fact1: MobileNetV2 transfer learning on the PlantVillage dataset
techStack.fact2: Grad-CAM heatmaps show where the model looked
techStack.fact3: Results under 70% confidence go to an Agricultural Officer
techStack.fact4: Sinhala & English, built mobile-first for farmers

tips.title: Tips for an Accurate Diagnosis
tips.subtitle: Follow these field photography guidelines for the best AI accuracy
tips.tip1Desc: Center one affected leaf clearly in the frame rather than the whole plant.
tips.tip2Desc: Take the photo in bright daylight without harsh shadows or camera flash glare.
tips.tip3Desc: Hold the leaf against a neutral surface or soil so the edges are clearly visible.
tips.tip4Desc: Make sure spots, yellowing, or lesions on the leaf blade are sharp and not blurry.

scanResult.whatIsHeatmapDesc: Grad-CAM (Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping) highlights the exact regions of the leaf that our MobileNetV2 neural network focused on. Warm red and yellow areas indicate strong disease lesion activation, while cool blue areas had minimal influence.

scanResult.verifyingNoticeDesc: Official symptoms, treatment dosages, and prevention guidelines for this condition are currently being verified against Department of Agriculture (Sri Lanka) sources. Please consult your district Agricultural Officer before applying chemical treatments.
